policy: supply-chain/policy.md section 1 (exact version, official source, digest, licence, 7-day rule) and D64/D65; the artifacts block equals tools/doc-parser/runtime-artifacts.json (embedded in oo)
decision_uv: policy.md has no rule against fetching a pinned release binary: a download is admitted when version and sha256 are pinned and checked before use. oo downloads the pinned uv into <state>/tools/uv-<version>/ and never uses a PATH uv (OO_UV overrides for operators). Published 2026-09-24, older than 7 days at adoption 2026-11-18.
decision_opencv: FFmpeg-free OpenCV wheel built from the sdist already admitted for the parser image, same CMake flags (FFmpeg, GStreamer, V4L, videoio off; AVFoundation and OpenCL off on macOS too). oo docs runtime install fails unless cv2 has no VideoCapture and no FFMPEG: YES.

artifacts.note: Pins used by `oo docs runtime install` (Docker-free parser, ADR-S14). Embedded in the oo binary; copy kept in supply-chain/runtime-artifacts-audit.json. A file is used only when its sha256 matches.

opencv.build: tools/doc-parser/build_opencv_wheel.sh: same sdist and CMake flags as the parser image stage `opencv` (FFmpeg, GStreamer, videoio off), MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0

macosx_arm64.note: placeholder URL: the owner publishes the wheel and replaces it; until then use OO_DOCS_OPENCV_WHEEL or <state>/artifacts/
